interface_review.finding: No static interface, registration or packaged-module blocker found for the declared fresh V2 reset collection and prediction-only diagnostic.
interface_review.memory_admission: Fresh V2 records explicitly carry reset memory. An all-V2 input does not require fabricating the absent memory_mode field in the old content-training receipt. Legacy V1 admission remains strict.
interface_review.macro_selector: Checks original train-only rows, the same behavior checkpoint, complete episode links and hashes, actual adjacent action/STOP or STOP-only terminal observations, and unchanged STOP utility. Earlier PREPARE actions are prefix state, not invented PREPARE/STOP outcomes.
interface_review.handoff: The driver's one input JSONL must include both calibration and diagnostic exports without changing original lines; pin the combined bytes. Calibration-only input cannot establish diagnostic results; diagnostic-only input fails calibration admission.
interface_review.cpu_worker: The CPU worker template CLI matches the driver and explicitly reports CPU use. Static review does not establish CUDA availability or successful cloud execution.

source_package.boundary: The model-source identity covers its declared model/numerical dependencies. The full archive manifest additionally covers the diagnostic helper, driver and collector; the model digest alone is not the full executable source identity.

denominators_and_costs.collection: All 60 planned requests are read back; Completed, Failed, Unresolved and Unstarted statuses are retained. Only verified completed episodes are exported.
denominators_and_costs.diagnostic: The diagnostic JSONL is conditional on completed observed episodes. It must be reported with the collection-result planned/attempted/failure inventory.
denominators_and_costs.unsupported: Observed unsupported macros retain point errors and reasons. Paired center/joint CRPS averages use supported observations only and average within source before across sources.
denominators_and_costs.partial_failure: Flushed rows and attempted/recorded counters survive a driver exception; status remains failed.
denominators_and_costs.durations: Action-only duration fields are preserved. Selected action/STOP and STOP-only macros overlap, so their seconds cannot be summed as collection cost. Full deployment/evaluation/outer-process receipts remain separate.
denominators_and_costs.collector_exit: Collector exit zero is not an all-episodes-success assertion; read its explicit dispositions and wall-limit observation.

weak_critic_baseline.finding: Content is pretrained, but the auxiliary utility/transition/duration/light heads were not fitted in the content stage. FrozenMacroPredictor point centers are therefore a weak, uncalibrated auxiliary-critic baseline.

original_training_source.method: Complete original source read through heptaruntime, with service SHA and independently recomputed SHA agreeing. Private host paths omitted.

exact_original_code_facts: The constructor is seeded before ReceiptPortfolioModel is created.
In _epochs, heads=[] for phase=content; Adam then receives only content_parameters.
content_parameters yields project, core, answer and box_delta, excluding utility_head, light_head and transition.
Content loss is text candidate CE plus four times box loss. Observed utility/transition/duration/light losses run only under phase=fit.
Fit epochs, residual fitting and the common_auxiliary_heads_trained receipt field are guarded by stage=fit.
weak_critic_baseline.provenance_caution: The imported GitHub training.py at commit 0287271 is not byte-identical to the receipt pin. This review uses the separately retrieved exact-pin original training.py rather than silently substituting the imported variant.
weak_critic_baseline.permitted_claim: Predictive improvement relative to this content-only checkpoint's untrained auxiliary point predictor on the observed macro distribution.
weak_critic_baseline.forbidden_inference: No evidence here of beating sufficiently trained critics/controllers, an action-only empirical baseline, or improving realized policy utility.

scientific_boundaries: Nearest-neighbor empirical residuals have no distribution-free conditional coverage guarantee.
Singleton/unsupported laws are not valid risk support; retain their denominator and reasons.
Horizon-one action-then-STOP diagnostics do not validate multi-step Generation v4 recursion or production Cell V2 ownership.
Source exclusion is relative to known original fit/tuning/quarantine rosters, not authenticated globally unseen exposure.
No generator or auxiliary critic was retrained. CRPS and predicted risk sensitivity are not actual policy outcomes.
The weak point baseline and absence of a matched action-only empirical comparison prevent attributing gain specifically to semantic conditioning.
Correlated tasks within six diagnostic sources are not independent training replications.
No Hepta-versus-ordinary architecture advantage, independent four-fit replication, general theoretical novelty or complete-cost stable net benefit is established.
